Subject: Finexa compliance checklist & next steps (audit logs, DPA, pen test)

Hi Samir —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Short recap from our call and proposed next steps so we stay aligned on priorities and timelines. Please reply if I've missed anything.

Key pain points you emphasized
- Need SOC 2 evidence for our controls mapping + timing for a Type II report (you said 6–9 months min).
- Audit log retention: product must preserve immutable request/response logs for 12–24 months depending on account scope; you want exportability.
- DPA edits: Finexa legal will request a data residency and subprocessor clause clarification.
- Pen test: Finexa requires proof of third-party pentest (or customer-facing pen test scope + schedule) before pilot sign-off.

Goals we agreed on
1) Confirm whether Redwood can supply the prioritized artifacts for SOC 2 scoping (control matrix, evidence examples) by EOD next week (Jul 20).
2) Provide a retention matrix showing which logs are retained, retention periods, and export formats by Jul 21.
3) Draft DPA changes and share a first-pass DocuSign link for review by Finexa legal by Jul 28.
4) Define pen test scope and timeline; Redwood to propose a scoped approach (internal test + vendor report or attestation) by Jul 23.

Owners / quick asks
- Karthik Iyer (cc) to own pen-test scoping and provide the suggested template and timeline.
- Olga Petrov (cc) to assemble the retention matrix and artifact mapping; she'll also attach relevant log-schema docs.
- I (neha_kapoor) will coordinate legal/procurement conversation and consolidate artifacts into a single Drive folder.

Attachments sent with this message: SOC2-questionnaire.xlsx (spreadsheet) — a short set of control-level asks we can pre-fill; retention_matrix_v2.pdf (stub) — baseline we will refine; pen_test_scope_template.docx — suggested scope doc.

Next steps (dates)
- Jul 20: Redwood returns SOC 2 artifact list (owner: Neha).
- Jul 21: Retention matrix + export samples (owner: Olga).
- Jul 23: Pen test scoping proposal + vendor options (owner: Karthik).
- Jul 28: DPA first-pass for Finexa legal (owner: Neha).

If these deadlines look at all aggressive, say so now and we can push a week — our priority is to get Finexa into a short POC window without surprises.

Best,
Neha Kapoor

- SOC 2: we want examples of the mapping between controls and artifacts (not just a list) — checkboxes we can hand to our auditor.
- Pen test: ideally we see a vendor report from the last 12 months or a vendor-approved program that we can run in our POC window.

Procurement note: our procurement window opens Jul 26 — if we can get the DPA edits in the week prior that will speed signatures.

I'll review the attachments and flag any legal asks. Please include our security engineer Ben Gupta (ben.gupta@finexa.com) on the pen-test thread when you have a scope.
